findings.title: Missing or incorrect Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: Restricts which sources the browser may load content from.
findings.evidence: The response did not include this header.
findings.remediation: Set a Content-Security-Policy that matches the site's required resources.

findings.title: Missing or incorrect X-Content-Type-Options
findings.description: Prevents browsers from guessing a different content type.
findings.evidence: The response did not include this header.

findings.title: Missing or incorrect Referrer-Policy
findings.description: Controls how much referrer information is sent with navigation requests.
findings.evidence: The response did not include this header.
findings.remediation: Set Referrer-Policy to strict-origin-when-cross-origin or a stricter policy.

findings.title: Missing or incorrect Permissions-Policy
findings.description: Restricts access to browser features that this demo does not need.
findings.evidence: The response did not include this header.
findings.remediation: Set a Permissions-Policy that disables unused browser features.

limitations: Checks only the listed HTTP response headers and status code.
Does not assess application vulnerabilities or establish that a website is secure.

publication.display: Sanitized sample from the local AegisAI demo site
